responsibility: Contains the rs6000 machine-description support for Power10 Matrix-Multiply Assist instructions and the opaque __vector_quad/__vector_pair data model. It defines the MMA-specific UNSPEC/UNSPECV codes, operand iterators, accumulator/vector/pair instruction families, and assembly/extract/setacc patterns used by builtins and code generation to lower matrix assist operations onto the MMA ISA.
